recipe_version.title: Swedish Pytt i Panna Ham and Potato Hash with Pan-Fried Eggs and Pickled Beets
recipe_version.description: Diced Yukon Gold potatoes browned crisp in butter and oil with onion, diced ham, and smoked kielbasa, topped with pan-fried eggs, and served with pickled beets and chopped parsley.

ingredients.name: ham
ingredients.display_name: cooked ham steak whose label lists pork, water, salt, sugar, sodium phosphate, and sodium nitrite

ingredients.name: kielbasa
ingredients.display_name: smoked kielbasa whose label lists pork, beef, water, salt, spices, garlic, and sodium nitrite

ingredients.name: pickled beets
ingredients.display_name: sliced pickled beets whose label lists beets, water, sugar, vinegar, and salt

steps.title: Prep
steps.body: Cut the potatoes, onion, ham, and kielbasa into even 1/2-inch dice. Chop the parsley and drain the beets.

steps.title: Cook the potatoes
steps.body: Brown the potatoes in 2 batches so each lies in one layer. Heat 1 tbsp of the oil and 1 tbsp butter in the 12-inch skillet over medium, about 2 minutes. Add half the potatoes with half the salt, cover, and cook 7 minutes, stirring once. Uncover and cook, turning every few minutes, until tender and browned, about 8 minutes more, then move them to a plate. Add the remaining 1 tbsp oil and brown the rest of the potatoes with the rest of the salt the same way, about 15 minutes, then return the first batch to the skillet.

steps.title: Onion
steps.body: Push the potatoes aside, add 1 tbsp butter and the onion, and cook until soft and golden, about 5 minutes.

steps.title: Brown the meat
steps.body: Add the ham and kielbasa and cook, turning occasionally, until browned at the edges and hot, about 7 minutes. Season with pepper.

steps.title: Pan-fried eggs
steps.body: While the meat browns (overlap stated): melt 1 tbsp butter in the 10-inch nonstick skillet over medium, crack in the 4 eggs, and pan-fry until the whites set, about 4 minutes (cover for firmer yolks).

steps.title: Serve
steps.body: Divide the hash among plates, top each with an egg, scatter parsley, and serve with pickled beets.
